bottleneck_link: At every one of 18 forward calls the paid profile changes by H1-10, H2-2, H3+2, H4-4, H5+5 and helper credits by H4+1, H5-1, H8-2, H9+2, a strict concave-moment gain with unchanged fields, scalar work and main endpoints.
